```{r}
theme_sym <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      # General plot style
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 1),
      
      # Axis text and titles
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      
      # Panel and grid lines
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      
      # Legend
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      
      # Facet labels
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
    )
}


```


# obtain all reference data for the target genes

```{r}
X10_library<- read.csv(file="input/sym10X_01_final_oligo_library.csv")
X10_library<- do.call("data.frame", X10_library)

unique_genes<- X10_library %>% filter(!(uniqueGuideName %in% c("NT_G1", "NT_G2", "NT_G3"))) %>%   dplyr::select(Gene, Transcript_ID) %>% unique()

ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

gene_data<- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol","ensembl_gene_id","ensembl_transcript_id", "chromosome_name", "start_position", "end_position", "strand","transcript_length","transcript_count","gene_biotype"),
  filters = "hgnc_symbol",
  values = unique_genes$Gene,
  mart = ensembl
)

gene_data<- gene_data %>% filter(ensembl_transcript_id %in% unique_genes$Transcript_ID) %>% droplevels()

X10_library<- left_join(X10_library, gene_data, by=c("Transcript_ID"="ensembl_transcript_id"))


```


# expression of these genes in TracerX data

```{r}


tracer_x<- read.fst(path = "input/tracerX/2022-10-18_vst_counts.fst")
tracer_x_metadata<- read.csv(file = "input/tracerX/samples_metat_data_for_downstream_analysis.csv")


tracer_x_target<- tracer_x %>% filter(gene_id %in% unique_genes$Gene) %>% droplevels() %>% reshape2::melt()

tracer_x_target<- left_join(tracer_x_target, tracer_x_metadata, by=c("variable"="region"))

tracer_x_target$Histology <- as.factor(tracer_x_target$Histology)

my_comparisons <- list(c("LUAD", "Normal"), c("LUSC", "Normal"))
tracer_x_target$value<- as.numeric(tracer_x_target$value)

tracer_x_target %>%
  filter(Histology %in% c("LUAD", "LUSC", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = value, x = Histology, fill = Histology)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~gene_id, scales = "free") +
  stat_compare_means(
    ref.group = "Normal", 
    label = "p.signif", vjust = 1
  )+theme_sym()+
  scale_fill_nejm()+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  ylab("Normalised TPM")+
  ggtitle("Expression of selected genes in lung cancer samples analysed in TracerX study")
 

tracer_x_target %>%
  filter(Histology %in% c("LUAD", "LUSC")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = value, x = timing, fill = timing)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~gene_id, scales = "free") +
  stat_compare_means(
    label = "p.signif", vjust = 1
  )+theme_sym()+
  scale_fill_nejm()+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  ylab("Normalised TPM")+
  ggtitle("Expression of selected genes in lung cancer samples analysed in TracerX study") 


#average gene expression in tracerX data


tracer_x_target_gene_av_all<- tracer_x_target %>% group_by(gene_id) %>% summarise(value=mean(value)) %>% mutate(Histology="Average", type="Average")
tracer_x_target_gene_av<- tracer_x_target %>% group_by(gene_id, Histology) %>% summarise(value=mean(value))%>% mutate(type="")

tracer_x_target_av_all<- rbind(tracer_x_target_gene_av, tracer_x_target_gene_av_all)

tracer_x_target_av_all %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = factor(gene_id, levels = tracer_x_target_gene_av_all$gene_id[order(tracer_x_target_gene_av_all$value, decreasing = TRUE)])) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y=gene_id, x= Histology, fill = log2(value))) +
  geom_tile(colour = "black") +
  theme_sym()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), axis.title = element_blank())+ ggtitle("Average Gene Expression in TracerX Data")+scale_fill_binned(low="blue", high="red", name="Log2(TPM)")+facet_grid(~type, scales="free", space = "free")

ggsave(filename = paste0("graphs/tracerX/average_gene_exp_in_tracerX_",Sys.Date(),".jpg"), width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 1000)
  

#average gene expression in tracerX samples

tracer_x_target <- tracer_x_target %>% mutate(hist_2=case_when(
  Histology=="Adenosquamous carcinoma" ~"ASC",
  Histology=="Large cell carcinoma" ~ "LCC",
  Histology=="Pleomorphic carcinoma" ~ "PMC",
  TRUE~Histology
))

tracer_x_target %>% ggplot(aes(y=gene_id, x= variable, fill = log2(value))) +geom_tile()+
  theme_sym()+
  ggtitle("Gene Expression in TracerX Tumor and Normal Samples" )+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(angle=90),plot.title = element_text(size = 14), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())+ 
  scale_fill_binned(low="blue", high="red", name="Log2(TPM)")+
  facet_grid(~hist_2, scales="free", space = "free")

ggsave(filename = paste0("graphs/tracerX/gene_exp_in_tracerX_tumor_and_Normal_",Sys.Date(),".jpg"), width = 25, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 1000)
  

```


target expression in Depmap

```{r}

depmap_exp_data<- read_csv(file="input/depmap/all_depmap_rsem_seq_curated.csv")


depmap_target<- depmap_exp_data %>% filter(GeneSymbol %in% unique_genes$Gene) %>% droplevels() %>% reshape2::melt()

omics_profiles<- read.csv(file="input/depmap/OmicsProfiles.csv")
model<- read.csv(file="input/depmap/Model.csv")

selected_omic_profiles<- omics_profiles %>% filter(ProfileID %in% depmap_target$variable)

selected_omic_profiles<- left_join(selected_omic_profiles, model, by="ModelID") 
selected_omic_profiles<- selected_omic_profiles %>% dplyr::select(ProfileID, ModelID, StrippedCellLineName, OncotreeCode, PrimaryOrMetastasis,OncotreeLineage)

depmap_target<- left_join(depmap_target, selected_omic_profiles, by=c("variable"="ProfileID"))
depmap_target <- depmap_target %>% group_by(GeneSymbol) %>% mutate(average_exp=round(mean(value),1))
median_exp<- depmap_target %>% group_by(GeneSymbol) %>% summarise(median_exp=round(median(value),1))
median_lung_exp<- depmap_target %>%filter(OncotreeLineage=="Lung") %>%  group_by(GeneSymbol) %>% summarise(median_exp=round(median(value),1))

target_genes<- unique(depmap_target$GeneSymbol)
index<- seq(1:length(target_genes))


for(i in index){
plot<- depmap_target %>% filter(!is.na(OncotreeLineage)) %>% 
  filter(GeneSymbol == target_genes[i]) %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = log10(value), x = OncotreeLineage)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median_exp %>% 
               filter(GeneSymbol == target_genes[i]) %>% 
               pull(median_exp) %>% log10(), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+theme_sym()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90), axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "none") +ylab("Log10(TPM)")+
  ggtitle(paste0(target_genes[i]))
ggsave(plot = plot, filename = paste0("graphs/dep_map_exp_plots/",target_genes[i],".jpg"), width = 25, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 1000)
}
 



for(i in index){
plot<- depmap_target %>% 
 filter(OncotreeLineage=="Lung") %>%  filter(GeneSymbol == target_genes[i]) %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = log10(value), x = OncotreeCode)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="gray") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median_lung_exp %>% 
               filter(GeneSymbol == target_genes[i]) %>% 
               pull(median_exp) %>% log10(), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+theme_sym()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90), axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "none") +ylab("Log10(TPM)")+
  ggtitle(paste0(target_genes[i]))
ggsave(plot = plot, filename = paste0("graphs/dep_map_exp_plots/lung_",target_genes[i],".jpg"), width = 25, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 1000)
}


comparisons <- list(c("LUAD", "LUSC"))


depmap_target %>%
  filter(OncotreeCode %in% c("LUAD", "LUSC")) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = log10(value), x = OncotreeCode, fill = OncotreeCode)) + facet_wrap(~GeneSymbol, nrow=3)+
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  stat_compare_means(
                # Specify test method
    comparisons = list(c("LUAD", "LUSC")),  # Compare LUAD vs LUSC
    label = "p.signif",            # Show significance stars
    group.by = "GeneSymbol",       # Group within each GeneSymbol
    na.rm = TRUE ,hide.ns = TRUE,                  # Handle missing values
    vjust=1.5
  ) +
  ylab("log10(TPM)") +
  ggtitle("Significance Analysis of Gene Expression by Oncotree Code\nDepmap Cell Lines") +
  theme_sym()+theme(axis.line.x =element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line())+
  scale_fill_nejm()



# Calculate average expression per gene within depmap cell lines
a<- depmap_target %>% group_by(GeneSymbol) %>% summarise(value=mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mutate(ModelID="average", OncotreeLineage="Average", Type="Average")

depmap_target_average_by_lineage<-depmap_target %>% group_by(GeneSymbol, OncotreeLineage) %>% summarise(value=mean(value, na.rm = TRUE))%>% filter(OncotreeLineage!="") %>% mutate(type="Cell Lines" )

depmap_target_average_by_lineage<- rbind(depmap_target_average_by_lineage,a)

depmap_target_average_by_lineage  %>%
 mutate(GeneSymbol = factor(GeneSymbol, levels = a$GeneSymbol[order(a$value, decreasing = TRUE)])) %>% 

 ggplot(aes(x = OncotreeLineage, y = GeneSymbol, fill = log2(value))) +
  geom_tile(colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_binned(name = "Expression\nLog2(TPM)", low = "blue", high = "red") +
  theme_sym() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90), 
        strip.text = element_text(),  
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Average Gene Expression by Lineage of Depmap Cell Lines\nn=", length(unique(depmap_target$ModelID))))+
  facet_grid(~type,space = "free", scales="free")

a

b<- depmap_target  %>% dplyr::select(GeneSymbol, value,ModelID, OncotreeLineage) %>% mutate(Type="Cell Lines")
p<- rbind(a,b)




p_ordered <- p %>%
  mutate(GeneSymbol = factor(GeneSymbol, 
                            levels = a$GeneSymbol[order(a$value, decreasing = TRUE)]))
p_ordered$OncotreeLineage <- factor(
  p_ordered$OncotreeLineage,
  levels = c("Average", setdiff(unique(p_ordered$OncotreeLineage), "Average"))
)


# Plot the heatmap


plot_1 <- ggplot(p_ordered, aes(x = ModelID, y = GeneSymbol, fill = log2(value))) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "Expression\nLog2(TPM)", low = "white", high = "red") +
  theme_sym() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(angle=90), 
        axis.title = element_blank())+ggtitle("Cell Lines")+facet_grid(~OncotreeLineage, scales="free", )
```
